name: Ollama Cloud Cost
author: Neil
description: Live Ollama Cloud plan usage in a bar dropdown: included credits used, remaining credit and the billing-period reset date.

barWidget.description: Tracks Ollama Cloud plan usage. Bar shows the Ollama icon (omarchy font), in the warning colour when the included usage is used up; click opens a dropdown with included credits used, remaining credit, reset date, keys and period requests.
